title: Relay B: Apple Catch Can't Count (bug hunt)
body:
Goal: build a broken catch game exactly as shown, then find and fix its two bugs. Tool: Scratch app (offline). Work as a relay team.

What it should do

  • Every game starts with a score of 0.
  • Apples fall from surprise places at the top.
  • Every apple caught in the bowl adds exactly 1 to the score.
  • Missed apples go back to the top.

Build steps

  1. Start a new project. Delete the cat. Add the Bowl and Apple sprites.
  2. Make a variable score (For all sprites).
  3. Build the two scripts below exactly as written, bugs and all.
  4. Play two games (click the green flag, play, then click the green flag again). Compare with "What it should do".
  5. Use the four detective steps. Fix one thing at a time and test after each change.
  6. Write both bugs and fixes on your relay baton (workbook, Exercise 6.2).

The scripts in words (with two bugs)

Bowl:

  • when green flag clicked
  • go to x: 0 y: -140
  • forever:
    • set x to (mouse x)

Apple:

  • when green flag clicked
  • go to x: (pick random -200 to 200) y: 170
  • forever:
    • change y by -5
    • if touching Bowl? then
      • change score by 1
    • if (y position) < -170 then
      • go to x: (pick random -200 to 200) y: 170

Expected behavior

After your fixes: every game starts with the score at 0. The bowl follows the mouse along the bottom. Apples fall from random places; each one you catch adds exactly 1 and a new apple starts at the top; missed apples also start again at the top.

Checklist

hints.label: Hint 1
hints.title: Where to look
hints.html: Play two games in a row. Watch the score at the start of the second game. Then catch just one apple and watch how fast the score jumps.

hints.label: Hint 2
hints.title: Try this
hints.html: Bug one is about what the score is when a game begins. Bug two is about what the apple does right after you catch it. Compare the catch if block with the missed-apple if block. Does one have something the other does not?

hints.label: Hint 3
hints.title: Almost there
hints.html: For bug one, look through the Variables category and ask which block lets every game begin fresh. For bug two, ask why the apple keeps touching the bowl after a catch. What does the missed-apple if do that the catch if does not?
